consultation.description: A one-to-one technical consultation to review your requirements, discuss architecture and identify next steps. Development, implementation and a detailed SRS are quoted separately.

packages.name: Business website
packages.summary: A focused, responsive website for a business or independent professional.
scope: Up to 5 public pages and 15 content sections
Responsive layouts for mobile, tablet and desktop
1 contact form with validation and email delivery
Page titles, descriptions and basic technical SEO setup
2 consolidated design revision rounds
packages.exclusions: Copywriting, branding, e-commerce, user accounts, CMS and paid integrations are not included.
packages.timeline: About 2 weeks after content and access are ready

packages.name: Backend & API development
packages.summary: A documented backend for one application or business workflow.
scope: Up to 8 API endpoints, including authentication routes
1 database with up to 5 data models
1 email/password sign-in flow and up to 2 access roles
Input validation, access checks and agreed error handling
API documentation and setup instructions
packages.exclusions: Frontend/admin UI, data migration, complex real-time features and additional integrations are quoted separately.
packages.timeline: About 2–3 weeks after the API specification is approved

packages.name: DevOps & deployment setup
packages.summary: Deploy an existing application with a repeatable release process.
scope: 1 application: one frontend, one backend and one database connection
1 production environment on client-owned cloud infrastructure
HTTPS, domain configuration and environment setup
1 CI/CD pipeline for one repository
Health checks, deployment notes and 1 handover session
packages.exclusions: Cloud/domain charges, Kubernetes clusters, migration, 24/7 monitoring and ongoing server operations are not included.
packages.timeline: About 3–5 business days once the application is deployment-ready

packages.name: AWS review & optimisation
packages.summary: Review a small AWS setup and prioritise practical improvements.
scope: Review of 1 AWS account and up to 5 existing resources
Review of resource sizing, cost visibility and access configuration
A prioritised written recommendations report
Setup of 1 budget notification using client-approved thresholds
Implementation of 1 agreed, reversible configuration improvement
packages.exclusions: Cloud usage charges, migrations, formal security audits and guaranteed cost savings are not included. Changes require client approval.
packages.timeline: About 3–5 business days after suitable access is provided

packages.name: Website & backend launch bundle
packages.summary: A small business application, from public pages to deployment.
scope: Up to 5 responsive public pages and 1 contact form
Up to 8 API endpoints, including one authentication flow
1 database with up to 5 models and up to 2 access roles
1 production deployment and CI/CD pipeline for one repository
API/setup documentation and 1 handover session
packages.exclusions: A custom admin UI, e-commerce, migrations, paid services, hosting and domain fees are quoted separately.
packages.timeline: About 4–6 weeks after scope, content and access are approved

commercialNotes: Base fees cover the listed scope. Applicable taxes and the final payable total are confirmed in your written quotation before acceptance.
Extra pages, endpoints, integrations and revisions need a separate quotation and your approval before work starts.
25% before onboarding, 25% after MVP approval, 40% after completion approval and 10% after deployment approval.
30 calendar days of agreed-scope defect support from recorded production deployment. New features and ongoing operations are separate.
Cloud, domain, API and licence charges are separate client costs. These packages cover development and technical services, not hosting resale or streaming subscriptions.
